tools.name: create_booking
tools.description: Creates a new booking (a check-in workflow) for one of the host's properties. Requires the write permission granted separately during sign-in. Ask the host to confirm the property and dates before calling this. Does not email the guest — call send_guest_checkin_link afterwards if a link should go ou

tools.name: send_guest_checkin_link
tools.description: Sends (or resends) the guest check-in link by email for a booking the host owns. This is a real action with a side effect: it emails the guest and, on resend, invalidates the guest's previous link. Requires the write permission granted separately during sign-in. Ask the host to confirm before callin

tools.name: list_ses_statuses
tools.description: SES.HOSPEDAJES (police registration) submission status for a set of bookings the host owns: status, attempts, last error, and the official reference once accepted. Bookings with no submission yet are omitted.

tools.name: get_guest_form_status
tools.description: Whether the guest has completed the check-in form for a booking the host owns (None or Submitted). No form content.

tools.name: list_bookings
tools.description: Lists the signed-in host's bookings (newest first), paged. Returns id, property id, check-in/check-out dates, status, and whether a check-in link and guest contact exist — never the guest's email, phone, or documents.

tools.name: get_attention_required
tools.description: Scans the signed-in host's most recent bookings (up to 50) and returns only what needs action right now: stays that are imminent or under way where the guest has not completed check-in, and bookings whose SES.HOSPEDAJES submission failed. Empty list means nothing needs attention within the window. N

tools.name: list_properties
tools.description: Lists the signed-in host's properties: id, name, address, municipality/province, and whether it is archived. No guest data.

tools.name: get_usage_summary
tools.description: The signed-in host's plan tier, trial status, and this month's usage against plan limits (properties, templates, bookings).

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "create_booking" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: create_booking, send_guest_checkin_link, list_bookings · Private data: list_bookings · Public sink: create_booking, send_guest_checkin_link, list_bookings.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: create_booking, send_guest_checkin_link, list_bookings · Private data: list_bookings · Public sink: create_booking, send_guest_checkin_link, list_bookings

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
